meta.name: Halation
meta.author: Aditya Himawan
meta.essence: Light does not stop at the edge of what it lights.
meta.promise: Every pane earns its blur: one refraction, one specular edge, one colour that escapes.
meta.oneSentence: An interface identity of reeded prismatic glass over warm porcelain: a pane of smoked ribs with a single reed of coral light that runs past its top and bottom edge, proven on a coral field by day and an ember field by night.

theme.material: reeded glass, 4 mm ribs at 9 mm pitch, over porcelain by day and ember by night
theme.edge: 1px specular hairline — white at 55% on the top and left edge only, ink at 10% on the bottom
theme.offset: panes lift by the specular edge, never by a shadow; shadow is reserved for the one floating layer
theme.refraction: the pane tints what it covers toward coral at 8% and offsets its backdrop by 0.6px
theme.tile: 64 grid, 4 unit rib, 36 × 44 pane, 6 gap, 5 × 64 spill to the canvas edge
theme.radius: 3 on a rib · 8 on a field crop · 14 on a pane · 22 on a sheet · 999 on a pill
theme.label: mono 10.5px, 0.16em, uppercase
theme.mark-form: a ribbed pane with one reed of light that runs past its edge to the edge of the canvas
